instructions: OnCo is a public cancer knowledge base read by patients. Review pull requests for: invented facts or numbers without a source link; medical or regulatory claims that lack a primary source (FDA, EMA, ClinicalTrials.gov, a journal DOI); survival figures outside the existing disclosure component; UK spelling; em-dashes or en-dashes in UI strings or data (write a hyphen or rephrase); links to record ids that do not exist in the corpus; duplicate record ids; new technologies without a SCHEMATIC_ALIAS entry; new cancers without an organ-schematics mapping; React anchors nested inside anchors; multi-child <title> elements in SVG; secrets or API keys; dependencies added to package.json. Be concise and cite the file and line. Do not comment on formatting the linter already enforces.

files.description: Contributor rules including the sourcing requirement
Which sources are acceptable for medical facts
Zod schemas every record must satisfy

rules.rule: Every new drug approval, trial result or survival number must carry a source URL in the record
No em-dash or en-dash characters; use a hyphen or rephrase
A Link or anchor must never contain another Link or anchor
Never add a dependency without discussing it in the pull request description
